description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements the 'LogNode' interface and functions as a logging filter that forwards only message content to the next node, omitting metadata such as tags, priorities, and throwables. It is used in logging pipelines to simplify log output by filtering out non-message information.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter for log nodes that outputs only message content, useful for on-screen logs where metadata is unnecessary.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes a LogNode to chain to; sets up the filter with the next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides the LogNode interface method; forwards only the message (msg) to the next node in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
